sites.title: Run your site from your pocket
sites.body: Posts, tasks, donations and the inbox in one place. The menu follows your Flux Admin layout.

look.title: Same look, light and dark
look.body: Anthracite and beige, indigo buttons. Your site’s theme colors take over once you connect.

safe.title: Your password stays out of the app
safe.body: You approve sign-in in the browser. Add another site whenever you want.

welcome.bandBody: Flux Admin’s calm layout. Look through three steps, then connect your site.
welcome.cardBody: Your WordPress address is enough. After that, the site’s own theme takes over.

addSite.title: Connect your site
addSite.browserHint: You sign in inside the app's secure browser. Your password never reaches the app.
addSite.notAllowed: This app cannot connect to that site.
addSite.allowedHint: This app only connects to the sites below.
addSite.noFluxApp: An active Flux App plugin was not found on this site. Install and activate it, then try again. Application passwords are available in limited mode.
addSite.secondAccount: Sign in with another account on this site
addSite.insecure: Application passwords only work on HTTPS sites.
addSite.appNotAllowed: This site has turned off the FluxWP app; only its own branded app can sign in.
addSite.connectionTitle: Unable to connect to your site
addSite.fluxAppRequired: To connect your site, the Flux App plugin must be installed and active in WordPress. If it is already active, check the site address and access settings, then try again.

switcher.title: Accounts
switcher.removeConfirm: Remove the {{site}} account from this device?

web.error: The page could not be opened.
web.demo: Demo: sample dashboard page (a real site opens signed in)
web.sessionLost: The dashboard session could not be opened. Try again, or sign out of the account and back in.

shell.native: This screen is coming to the app soon.

inbox.title: Messages
inbox.deleteEveryoneBody: The contact sees "This message was deleted". The record stays in the panel.
inbox.deletePanelAsk: Hide this message in the panel?
inbox.deletePanelBody: The message stays on the contact's phone. "Show" opens it again in the panel.

review.title: Waiting for approval
review.emptyBody: A new receipt will show up here.

post.title: New post
post.name: Title
post.hint: Write the text in the editor below. Full screen adds headings, lists and images.

media.title: Media
media.emptyBody: Add an image from the camera or the gallery.

social.title: New post
social.placeholder: What do you want to share?
social.need: Pick an account and write something

ai.title: Flux AI
ai.notReady: Flux AI is not set up yet
ai.deleteBody: The chat and the files in its folder are deleted.

tv.title: TV Remote
tv.wifiOff: You are not on the same Wi-Fi. The command was not sent.

privacy.connection: Sign-in and site actions go to the WordPress site you choose. Your site operator has its own privacy policy.
privacy.usage: Off by default. With your choice and the site administrator’s permission, the site counts daily active accounts by iOS/Android. Only totals for groups of at least five are shared with FluxWP, with the site’s configured country. No names, content or GPS location are sent. You can change this choice at any time.
privacy.continueTerms: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms>. <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
